question: Is the RUNNING graphify_runs state genuinely stale, or is it backed by a live process this session hasn't found yet?
method: Independent re-verification (not trusting the prior workspace-source-namespace-v1.json claim at face value): queried all graphify_runs rows directly, checked for a live node.exe process, checked .tmp/graphify-daemon.pid's age and whether its PID is running, and separately noted but did not touch .git/index.lock.

findings.liveProcessCheck: tasklist for node.exe shows many unrelated running Node processes (this dev environment, other tooling) but no evidence tying any of them to a graphify run.

lockFileCheck.verdict: STALE -- predates even the oldest graphify_runs row by 2 months; the process it names does not exist.

unrelatedArtifactNoted.note: Exists and is recent, but is a git-tooling artifact, not a graphify lock. Not touched, not implicated in this finding.

conclusion: STALE_RUN_NON_PROMOTABLE, independently re-confirmed. All 5 recorded graphify_runs rows are RUNNING with no completed_at, ranging 5-6 days old, and none is backed by any live process or valid lock. This repo has never recorded a single completed graphify run. This is a genuine human/lifecycle decision (abandon the stale rows / supersede them with a fresh run / investigate why runs never complete their own status transition) -- not something to resolve by running graphify:daily to force a new revision token, and not something this read-only audit resolves unilaterally.
decisionPointForOperator: Option A: Mark the 5 stale RUNNING rows as ABANDONED/FAILED (requires a real write -- out of scope for this read-only audit) and let a future graphify:daily naturally produce a fresh, real completed run.

Option B: Investigate why graphify_runs' own writer never transitions status to COMPLETED even on success -- possibly a real bug in the runner/writer, not just an operational gap. Not investigated this pass (would require reading the graphify run orchestrator code, out of scope for a DB-only audit).
Option C: Leave as-is and continue treating LINEAGE-01/PKT-LINEAGE-08 as blocked until a human decides which of the above to pursue.
